title: Quick Peruvian Tuna Suspiro Limeno Bowl
description: A tangy, silky bowl of seared tuna, sesame butter sauce, and fluffy rice, inspired by Peruvian flavors and the light texture of suspiro limeno.

ingredients.name: sesame butter
ingredients.notes: butter blended with toasted sesame paste

instructions: Rinse and drain the jasmine rice, then cook according to package instructions.
In a small bowl whisk together sesame butter, dashi extract, low sodium soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, and grated ginger until smooth.
Pat the tuna steak dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and cracked pepper.
Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat and sear the tuna steak for 1 minute on each side for medium-rare.
Slice the seared tuna into thin strips and transfer to a serving bowl.
Pour the tangy sesame sauce over the tuna strips, then add the cooked rice at the bottom of the bowl.
Garnish with sliced green onion, toasted sesame seeds, and a squeeze of fresh lime for extra brightness.
Serve immediately while the tuna is still warm, and enjoy the silky, tangy flavors of this Peruvian inspired bowl.
